in_sanskrit.name: Dablu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Elephant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dablu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Dablu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dabh' which means elephant. This name is given to children born under the influence of the elephant, symbolizing strength, loyalty and power.
